shapes.label: Service
shapes.comment: A service provided by an organization, e.g. delivery service, print services, etc.

property.name: keywords
property.description: Keywords or tags used to describe this content. Multiple entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas.

property.name: inLanguage
property.description: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

property.name: provider
property.description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller. Supersedes carrier.
